messages:
mira: FYI partners uploaded an updated supply matrix for Q4 — link: https://vendor.example.com/q4-supply (see region tabs)

dan: quick ask — can we get spot liquidity as a % of total pool by SKU? that's what finance needs for the burn model

olivia: asked vendor for 3 tenor splits (12/24/36) + early-exit fees. they said 24/36 are limited in apac.

arjun: also request per-region egress and cross-zone transfer fees. marketplace listing fees not included in their sheet.

marketplace-bot: Vendor "NebulaCompute" updated offer id nc-2028-q4 — commit tiers and ephemeral SKUs changed

mira: important: their spot pool is labelled "best-effort-ephemeral" with preemption window ~90s, and they have a small guaranteed pool for reserved customers.

dan: can we get expected utilization uplift if we push 50% of traffic to ephemeral? previous sims used 25% and it halved effective reserved consumption.

olivia: pricing inputs we need to capture in the model:
- base list price per-GPU-hour (by SKU)
- reserved discount by tenor
- spot average price + volatility (p95)
- marketplace listing fee % and flat per-hour fee
- minimum commitment (GPU-months) and ramp schedule

lex: i'd model three scenarios: base (vendor estimates), stressed (spot liquidity drops 40%), and opportunistic (marketplace credits + promo applied). use conservative latency fallback to a larger model if preempted.

arjun: small technical note — some SKUs in the sheet are mixed-precision only. need quantization-affinity tag so runtime can pick compatible model variants.

dan: finance also needs churn assumptions for reserved customers (early exit) and pro-rated refunds. can vendor give historical exit rates for last 18 months?

mira: they offered a window to negotiate a 10% listing waiver if we commit to a 12mo minimum in NA — that would change unit economics materially.

olivia: have them break out effective unit cost after waivers and credits. UI shows list price, but we need net price per-token estimate.

marketplace-bot: Scheduled: Vendor negotiation kickoff meeting — 1854030000 (thread: vendor-negotiation)/calendar invite sent

mira: action items:
- @arjun collect SKU compatibility/quant tags (due EOD)
- @olivia request spot price time series + p50/p90 (due tomorrow)
- @dan run sensitivity: reserved mix 30/50/70% and ephemeral preemption impact (due Fri)
- @lex confirm fallback model policy and per-token delta to use in cost sims

arjun: i'll also ask for SLA credits for preemptions >5% monthly. if they accept, that changes our fallback threshold.

dan: noted — i'll include marketplace fee sensitivity (0%/5%/12%) in the model.

mira: let's reconvene after we have the time series. thanks all :thumbsup:
